action_timeline.rationale: Prediction: restraint4 is destroyed and Durin is alive; retain all pending shell accounting.
Prediction: all hostile central traffic is cleared.
Prediction: all upper-outer hostiles are cleared.

battle_phases.completion_condition: All four holders, Ansel and Durin are alive and deployed before Spot's first activation.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A missed interception or lost Fang grant invalidates subsequent survival, income and caster timing.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interceptions without an unsupported economic or healing dependency.
handoff_requirements: Spot contributes officer damage before healing stops his attacks.
Durin must clear that remaining queue early enough to obtain artillery contact.
responsibilities: Fang holds upper center and supplies automatic income.
Noil Corne holds the first lower runner with stronger ordinary defense.
Plume and Spot establish both outer lanes.
Ansel begins central recovery; Durin assists the lower queue.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with 10 DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Plume survives her opening runner and officer until extended healing.
Noil Corne's early survival uses actual defense and HP, not a medic assumed to exist earlier.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Eastern restraint4 is destroyed, Durin withdraws alive, and all pending impacts are accounted for.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Caster death, insufficient artillery damage or delayed restraint destruction can kill a protected target or prevent central armor clearance.
battle_phases.goal: Survive exposed casts while obtaining enough artillery damage and releasing the lower civilian.
handoff_requirements: Durin's withdrawal releases no blocked enemy.
His living refund is 6 DP and his next deployment waits more than 70 seconds.
Steward retains artillery and central coverage during Durin's absence.
responsibilities: Spot heals local damaged operators while retaining lower blocking.
Ansel delivers timed caster healing and extended upper-outer recovery.
Durin damages artillery and destroys restraint4.
battle_phases.start_condition: Spot activates at frame 2011 and Steward enters at 2101.
survival_dependencies: Individual heal delivery must keep both fragile casters above lethal thresholds.
Durin must survive exposure until restraint4 destruction.
A released civilian must escape further acquisition before accumulated shells become lethal.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is dead with residual shells resolved, and central blocking remains available for the runner pairs.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Uncleared old armor consumes the slots needed by later runners and final armor.
battle_phases.goal: Finish artillery and remove old central armor before paired runners exhaust holder capacity.
handoff_requirements: No hostile is released to gain a nominal blocking slot.
responsibilities: Steward switches from artillery to armor whenever high-defense targeting permits.
Fang and Noil Corne retain their lanes.
Ansel's second activation supports the later artillery exposure and central recovery.
Spot holds and heals through the lower officer pair.
battle_phases.start_condition: Durin has withdrawn and first central armor approaches.
survival_dependencies: Steward's predicted contact count must actually produce artillery death before western civilian exposure.
Armor clearance must be observed rather than inferred from elapsed time.
Medical allocation must preserve both holders.

battle_phases.completion_condition: All hostile spawns are exhausted and all hostile enemies are defeated without leaks.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A lost holder, overflowing queue or delayed armor kill defeats zero-leak acceptance even if civilians later arrive.
battle_phases.goal: Clear the final runner and armor overlap with two arts attackers.
handoff_requirements: Confirm central and upper-outer hostile clearance before the scheduled western withdrawals.
Retain all seven-ID and cooldown constraints.
responsibilities: Durin restores lower-central and lower-outer damage.
Steward attacks central armor with supported priority.
Fang and Noil Corne provide actual blocking.
Spot, Ansel and Plume execute their final pressure skills.
survival_dependencies: Both physicians' nominal capacity is not assumed; this structure has one physician and Spot's limited local healing.
Use observed damage type and recipients; conservatively retain the prior full 340/2.8 armored incoming term until contradicted.
Noil Corne's defense reduces runner damage but does not prove survival of the mixed queue.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both expected protected targets have distinct safe-arrival events, with positive life, zero leaks, zero protected deaths and no active enemies.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unreleased or dead protected target prevents project acceptance regardless of remaining life.
battle_phases.goal: Release both western restraints and verify both protected objectives.
handoff_requirements: Observe safe arrivals rather than treating restraint destruction as completion.
responsibilities: Remaining holders preserve cleared corridors while civilians move.
battle_phases.start_condition: Hostile clearance is complete before frames 8400 and 8401.
survival_dependencies: Artillery and hostile officers are already dead.
Neither western deployment occupies a forbidden device tile.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward and Durin jointly kill artillery. Born shells persist through retreat and source death; account for their remaining impacts.
Plume destroys eastern restraint3. Keep western restraint1 until artillery and hostile upper traffic are cleared; final Steward releases the civilian safely.
Durin destroys eastern restraint4 before withdrawing. Spot blocks hostile officers, never the civilian. Final Plume destroys western restraint2.
Fang holds upper-central traffic. Steward supplies armor damage after artillery clearance. Clear an existing occupant before any third enemy reaches Fang's two-block position.
Noil Corne holds lower-central traffic. Returning Durin and persistent Steward clear armor and runners before a fourth enemy reaches the three-block holder.
Plume intercepts upper-outer enemies. Her first attack skill separates the ten-second officer pair; Ansel's active extension must restore her opening damage.
Spot contains lower-outer enemies throughout. Durin supplies damage when Spot heals; healing cannot erase an uncleared queue.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central interception, adjacent lower-central assistance and living deployment income.
Lower-central three-block containment; use ordinary stats without an unsupported talent.
Upper-outer interception and eastern upper restraint clearance.
Lower-outer interception, ordinary officer damage and timed local healing.
Both central holders and both initial caster positions; active extension also covers Plume.
Supplementary artillery damage, lower-outer clearance and eastern lower restraint destruction; return here after withdrawal.
Artillery during available contact windows, then continuous arts coverage of both central holders.

artillery_damage_hypothesis.conditional_budget: 41 ordinary Steward attack events, including eight enhanced events, plus six Durin arts hits give approximately 13026.62 damage to the 13000-HP artillery enemy.
artillery_damage_hypothesis.deadline: Artillery must die before its western approach can repeatedly attack the protected target held at the western upper restraint.
artillery_damage_hypothesis.limitation: This is a conditional damage calculation, not a verified contact count. Durin's blocked-officer targeting and Steward's interrupted range windows can invalidate it.
artillery_damage_hypothesis.minimum_observable_contribution: Durin must obtain at least six actual artillery damage events if Steward obtains only the stated 41-event budget.

economy.dependency: Fang grants require survival and deployment. Refunds require living withdrawals; death refunds zero. No charger kill income, unsupported talent or client cost escalation is assumed.

medical_geometry.limitation: Spot's healing is single-target, stops his attacks and does not guarantee Ansel can deliver every required central or caster heal.

formation_structure.structure: Four persistent lane holders, one physician, a healing guardian within the four holders, and two arts attackers with different coverage.
formation_structure.validation: Read-only roster, range, opening DP, declared SP spacing and redeployment-gap calculations performed. No stage simulation was run; full-stage success is unverified.

formation_transitions.transition: Finish four-lane interception before the first lower-outer runner reaches column five.
Spot changes from officer damage to healing after contributing to the opening lower queue. Durin inherits the remaining lower damage duty.
Ansel activates extended, stronger healing for upper-outer recovery and the first exposed caster interval.
Scheduled living Durin withdrawal after eastern lower restraint destruction and resolution of his assigned exposure. No blocked enemy is released because he occupies high ground.
Spot resumes healing during the later lower exposure and officer queue.
Ansel's second activation supports the later upper artillery exposure and central recovery.
Durin returns after 2101 frames, restoring lower-central and lower-outer arts damage.
Ansel's third activation supports the final central armor and runner overlap.
Withdraw Steward only under the plan's prediction that hostile clearance is already complete.
Withdraw Plume after upper-outer clearance; permanent central and lower holders remain.
Return Steward west to destroy the upper restraint.
Return Plume west to destroy the lower restraint and complete both protected-target routes.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: The selected list and every DEPLOY use exactly the same seven legal normal-mode rarity-1-to-3 IDs.
Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]]. Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and an explicit cardinal direction.
Acceptance requires positive remaining life, zero leaks, zero protected-target deaths, both expected safe arrivals, exhausted spawns and no active enemies.

Observe individual heals and pre-impact HP. Durin must exceed 938 HP before an otherwise unmitigated 938-damage shell; Steward must survive every 910-damage shell. Nominal combined HPS does not establish either.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Roadblock destruction releases civilians; physicians do not directly heal them.
Track selection, projectile birth, locked position, impact, splash recipients and intervening healing for every actual cast. Retreat never deletes a born shell.
Eastern restraint4 must be destroyed before Durin's scheduled withdrawal. Civilian artillery damage is permitted only while survival and eventual safe arrival remain established.
Observe actual BLOCK events. Fang has two slots and Noil Corne three; ranged occupants do not supply ground blocking.
Skill and retreat actions require a living deployed operator. A failed survival prediction invalidates dependent actions; it is not repaired by assumed refunds or instant replacement.
No death is required. Any death is assessed by absorbed attacks, damage, released enemies, lost income, zero refund, cooldown and successor coverage; it does not itself establish project failure.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Meet all four interception deadlines, retain Fang income, absorb opening damage with Noil Corne's ordinary defense, and damage the lower officer before Spot stops attacking.

Spot heals Ansel and Durin during clustered impacts. Ansel sustains the isolated upper caster and restores Plume. Durin must add artillery damage and finish eastern restraint4 before his scheduled withdrawal.
Resolve remaining shells, kill artillery before western civilian exposure, and have Steward clear the first central armor before paired runners exhaust blocking capacity.
Restore Durin's lower damage, preserve actual block slots for the final armor, and use medical activations for delivered healing rather than nominal HPS.
Keep cleared corridors safe, complete both western restraints and observe both distinct protected-target arrivals.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic supported DP only while alive and deployed.
No manual skill or unsupported talent is credited.
First boost prevents overlap of the ten-second upper officer pair; second accelerates final upper-outer clearance. No unsupported kill-DP talent is credited.
Heal Ansel, Durin and self in the supported nine-cell range. Attacks stop for 25 seconds; no dodge is credited.
Support exposed casters, restore Plume through range extension, and cover late central pressure. Do not assume probabilistic extra healing.
Ordinary arts damage only; unsupported dodge or other talent effects contribute zero.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks and high-defense priority. Artillery takes priority while in range; afterward central armor receives sustained arts damage.

tactical_thesis: Use seven IDs with four early interceptions, stronger lower-central defense, and two complementary casters. Spot combines lower-outer blocking with staged healing. Durin supplements Steward's artillery damage and clears the eastern lower restraint; Steward subsequently retains coverage of both central holders. This is an unsimulated, CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE hypothesis. Artillery damage, healing allocation, restraint clearance and actual interception remain decisive, falsifiable dependencies.
